newsitem.title: SPAIN: Stet aims to replace Telefonica in Unisource - press.
newsitem.headline: Stet aims to replace Telefonica in Unisource - press.

text.p: Italian state-controlled telecoms holding Stet is in talks to replace Spain's Telefonica in the European telecoms consortium Unisource, Spanish daily El Pais reported on Friday.
Telefonica has a 25 percent stake in the AT&T -directed consortium which groups Sweden's Telia, Swiss Telecom and Koninklijke PTT Nederland.
If Telefonica decides to team up with AT&T's rival MCI Communications Corp in the U.S. it might force a break with AT&T in Europe, leaving a space for Stet to occupy in Unisource, the report said.
Telefonica has said it will soon announce a U.S. partnership, and is in talks with all groups.
Analysts consider MCI to be Telefonica's most likely American partner.
